clues: This is the chief town of a vast, cold island land in the far north. It sits at the end of a long fjord, where the land meets a cold sea.
Winters here are long, cold, and full of snow, yet the sea keeps them less harsh. Far lands in the east and west at the same line freeze much more hard.
This town was founded in the year 1728 by a church man from lands far south. He came here when his first small camp was moved to this spot.
More than one third of all folk in this whole land live in this one town. That makes it one of the smallest chief towns on Earth.
This is the most far north chief town in the whole world. No other land's chief town sits so far up the globe.
